TRACEABILITY

MineLinjiang Ridge Gold Mine
LocationZhaoyuan, Shandong Province, China (37.3° N, 120.4° E)
OperatorLinjiang Resources Co.
Mine typeLarge-scale licensed underground mine, in operation since 2004
Share of gold58% from this mine; the other 42% is recycled gold from reclaimed jewellery and industrial offcuts
HOW THIS MAKES IT ETHICALLY SOURCED
  • No informal mining. A licensed, large-scale underground mine means no artisanal or informal workings enter the supply, so working conditions can be inspected.
  • Low-risk location. The mine lies outside conflict-affected and high-risk areas as defined by the OECD guidance on due diligence for mineral supply chains.
  • Audited every year. An independent assessor checks worker safety, fair pay and the absence of child or forced labour.
  • Environmental controls. Tailings are held in a lined storage facility and about 90% of process water is recycled.
  • Recycled share. The 42% recycled gold adds no new mining impact.
  • Provable chain. Batch code follows the gold from the mine gate to this piece, so each claim can be checked below.
Doré bars from the Linjiang Ridge mine and recycled scrap are refined to 999 fineness at an accredited refinery, Southern Delta Gold Refining Co. (illustrative name). An independent assay confirms 999.2 parts per thousand, and the report is filed under the certificate number shown below.

ROLE ON THIS PIECE

Each piece is tested by X-ray fluorescence, weighed and measured against its mould (), then checked under magnification for finish and setting. A serial number links the piece to barcode and its certificate.
The piece is packed in a presentation box with its certificate of authenticity, sealed with a tamper-evident label and delivered insured to your Singapore address. Delivery is free, and a signature is required on receipt.

THE STORY OF CTF • PALACE MUSEUM

A HERITAGE OF FIRSTS

  1. 1929Chow Tai Fook is founded in Guangzhou.
  2. 1972First to launch 999.9 gold jewellery in Hong Kong and Macao.
  3. 1990Introduces its “Fixed Price” policy: the price on the tag is the final price.
  4. 2014Master Studio begins working with the Chinese University of Hong Kong to study historic goldworking techniques.
  5. 2016Launches T•MARK, bringing traceability to its diamonds.
  6. 2023Begins a strategic partnership with the Palace Museum in Beijing.
  7. 2024Launches the Palace Museum Collection.

Terms and Conditions

Packaging

Your piece arrives in a Chow Tai Fook presentation box, wrapped in tissue and closed with a tamper-evident label.

The box contains a certificate of authenticity, a care card and a polishing cloth. Gift wrapping and a handwritten message card are available at checkout.

Delivery

Free Singapore delivery on all online orders.

Orders are dispatched within 2 to 3 working days and delivered by insured courier. A signature is required on receipt, so please choose an address where someone can accept the parcel.

Collection from selected Singapore stores is available at checkout.
